p: It says in the Magen Avraham
who cites the Yalkut on Rus:
"What does Rus have to do with Atzeres,
that it is read at the time of Matan Torah?
You prepare in Your goodness for the poor, O God'
before the Holy One, blessed be He:
Give my portion to the tribe of poverty,
for if the wealthy occupy themselves with me,
they will become haughty..." and so on.
וְהוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (נְדָרִים פא, א):
This is based on what Chazal say (Nedarim 81a):
"Be careful with the children of the poor,
for from them Torah will go forth..." and so on;
and the Ran explains, in his second explanation,
that they are humble in their own eyes.
וְהוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמַר (סוֹטָה כא, ב):
And this is based on what is said (Sotah 21b):
only in one who makes himself
'And wisdom — from nothingness it is found'" (Iyov 28:12).
"Why are words of Torah compared to water,
as it is written: 'Ho, everyone who thirsts,
Just as water leaves a high place...
only in one whose spirit is humble."
מוּסָב רַק עַל הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה,
refers only to Torah she'b'al peh,
which is what is compared to water,
as is expounded there just before:
and regarding a worthy student it says:
לִקְרַאת צָמֵא הֵתָיוּ מָיִם (יְשַׁעְיָה כא, יד).
And it is to Torah she'b'al peh
If so, what is the reason
that Rus is read on Atzeres,
when the Torah she'bi'chsav was given?
It would have been more fitting to read it
when the last Tablets were given;
and it says in the Midrash Rabbah
that there should be in them halachos, Midrash and Aggados,
is also the Torah she'b'al peh.
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאִיתָא (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא צא, ב):
according to what it says (Bava Basra 91b):
וַיָּשֶׂם כִּסֵּא לְאֵם הַמֶּלֶךְ (מְלָכִים א ב, יט) —
"'And he placed a throne for the king's mother' (Melachim I 2:19) —
from her began the building of the kingship
הָיָה רַבָּן שֶׁל בַּעֲלֵי רוּחַ הַקֹּדֶשׁ,
was the master of all those endowed with Ruach HaKodesh,
That is: since he is a chariot
we call it Torah she'b'al peh,"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב הָרַמְבַּ״ן (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא יב, א)
"Know this, for a great man states a matter
for then the kingship of the House of Dovid was built,
which was the root of Torah she'b'al peh.
And even though the root of Torah she'b'al peh
הוּא מִסִּטְרָא דְּעֵץ הַדַּעַת טוֹב וָרָע,
is from the side of the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק א כז, א),
מִכׇּל מָקוֹם מָצִינוּ (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה כה, א):
"Dovid, King of Yisrael, lives and endures";
and it also says (in Shemos Rabbah 8:1):
"At that moment Dovid came to life";
meaning, that he merited the Tree of Life,
for the time is then awakened
when the Commandments were bound with two crowns
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁעַל יְדֵי הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה,
That is: through the Torah she'b'al peh,
they can repair the "abundance of anger" (Koheles 1:18)
from the side of the Tree of Life.
And every year at the time of Matan Torah
what there was with the first Tablets:
the learning of Torah was implanted in their hearts,
and with the utterance "You shall have no other gods"
the yetzer hara was uprooted from their hearts,
and the words of Torah will be
from the side of the Tree of Life
And this is what is said in the holy Zohar
this is 'the river going forth from Eden,'
that is, Binah, the Supernal Mother,
as is written in the holy Zohar
(זֹהַר חֵלֶק א כו, א, סוֹף הָעַמּוּד);
and it is the aspect of teshuvah,
and he will repent and be healed" (Yeshayah 6:10).
is to repair the "abundance of anger"
עַל יְדֵי הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה וְהַתְּשׁוּבָה.
through Torah she'b'al peh and teshuvah.
חֲגִיגָה ב, ג; בֵּיצָה ב, ד;
and the Holy One, blessed be He, completes
מִן הַסְּתָם נוֹלַד גַּם כֵּן בַּעֲצֶרֶת;
presumably he was also born on Atzeres;
and so it is written in the sefarim.
And of Dovid HaMelech, alav hashalom,
הַגֶּבֶר הוּקַם עָל (שְׁמוּאֵל ב כג, א) —
"'The man who was raised on high' (Shmuel II 23:1) —
who raised up the yoke of teshuvah,"
in order to repair the "abundance of anger."
And this is the reason that Megillas Rus —
she being the mother of royalty,
that is, the root of the building
of the kingship of the House of Dovid —
for that is the time to repair,
from the side of the Tree of Life,
That is, Dovid HaMelech, alav hashalom,
so that they merit eternal life,
and death will be merely like sleep and awakening;
and as death is called in the language of Chazal
"'And when you awaken, it shall converse with you' —
